text: maya (Design): Quick heads-up — playing with a compact left nav variant that groups 'Models' + 'Deployments' under a new 'Workloads' cluster. Thinking microcopy: should the cluster label be 'Workloads' or 'Workspaces'? sam (Frontend): 'Workloads' reads slightly more technical, but 'Workspaces' is friendlier. UX-wise either is fine, but we need consistent breadcrumb labels e.g. breadcrumb -> Workloads / Models / . jonah (PM): Agree. Also want deep links to map clearly: proposed canonical paths: `/w/:orgId/workloads/:clusterType/:itemId` or simpler `/workspace/:id/model/:modelId`. Which is easier for routing? sam (Frontend): I'd lean `/workspace/:id/model/:modelId` — simpler to parse in the router and matches current shallow routing. Example fallback rule: if `:modelId` missing, render list view; if `:workspaceId` invalid, redirect to `/workspace` with toast. kevin (A11y): Accessibility nit: breadcrumbs need proper landmarks and aria-current on the last crumb. If we collapse nav groups, ensure the skiplink target moves to the 1st interactive element inside the pane. Also text for the skiplink should be "Skip to main navigation" not "Skip nav" (reads better with screen readers). maya (Design): Good catch. Also copy tweak: when collapsing groups we currently show `+` expand affordance. Could we try the chevron plus label pattern? e.g., `Workloads ▸` and on hover show `Expand` tooltip. Less ambiguous than `+`. sam (Frontend): Implementation note: chevron-only is fine, but we need a 44px tap target for mobile. We'll keep the whole row clickable and expose aria-expanded on the button element. Pseudocode: `` jonah (PM): On deep links and permalinks — a requirement from support: shareable link should always open the item in the same console view, even if the user prefers compact nav. So the route should carry state = `view=compact` as optional query param, not global UI cookie. e.g., `/workspace/123/model/xyz?view=compact`. kevin (A11y): For that query param, ensure screen reader announcements when view changes: `aria-live=\"polite\"` region that says "Navigation collapsed" so blind users are aware without the DOM shift being disorienting. maya (Design): UX question: breadcrumbs show abbreviated workspace names on narrow widths. Should we short-circuit long names with ellipsis + title attribute? Or prefer repeating full name in the dropdown? Thoughts? sam (Frontend): Ellipsis + `title` attribute is ok, but tooltips are inaccessible on touch. Better: show truncated text visually and expose full name in `aria-label`. Example: `Very Long W... ` jonah (PM): Also let's avoid relying on title for keyboard users. Good to include both `aria-label` and a visually-hidden full copy inside the crumb popover. kevin (A11y): Another accessibility nit: keyboard focus order after a breadcrumb link click should land on the next logical landmark (main content header). Use `element.focus()` and ensure focusable header present. Avoid moving focus to the top of page unexpectedly. maya (Design): Layout debate: compact nav (icons-only with hover labels) or grouped compact (icons + minimal label)? Pros of icons-only: density. Cons: discoverability. We should test with internal PMs + ops. Quick poll: :thumbsup: for icons-only, :raising_hand: for icons+mini-label. jonah (PM): I'll run a quick hallway test tomorrow. For the build, can we keep both modes toggled by `navMode` in local storage and a query param override? Devs prefer toggles so we can demo both. sam (Frontend): Yes — add `?navMode=compact` override. Implementation detail: router should normalize to canonical route (no duplicate slashes) and preserve `view` and `navMode` as optional params. We'll handle fallback in route-matcher. maya (Design): Small copy ask — the breadcrumb separator currently is `›`. Consider using `aria-hidden` on separators so SR doesn't read them as punctuation. Also change the visible separator to a slightly thinner glyph so it doesn't draw focus. kevin (A11y): Confirmed: separators should be `aria-hidden=\"true\"` and the crumb link should include `aria-current` for the active page. Also ensure color contrast for breadcrumbs meets AA (4.5:1) — currently the grey looks borderline on some screens. navbot (deploy-bot): Reminder: design branch `nav-compact-experiments` deployed to staging at `staging.redwood.internal/nav-test` (build 2026.03.22-9). maya (Design): Great — can folks try the staging link and drop quick reactions? I'm adding a small task list: 1) validate skiplink target, 2) check aria-live updates, 3) confirm breadcrumb contrast, 4) test permalink behavior. sam (Frontend): Will do. I'll post any smaller fixes here. jonah (PM): I'll collect PM feedback after hallway test and push decision on label copy. kevin (A11y): I'll run the screen reader pass and upload notes. Also adding a11y checklist: keyboard nav, focus order, aria-labels on truncated crumbs, aria-live for mode changes. maya (Design): Thanks team. If no objections by EOD Friday, we'll ship the compact grouping with the `Workloads` label and the aria tweaks above. :sparkles: sam (Frontend): :thumbsup: jonah (PM): :thumbsup: (reaction)
